close_reason: Decision record — captures a settled architectural choice already implemented in the crate. No code action required. The bead description preserves the rationale for future readers searching by topic; closing keeps the autonomous frontier focused on actionable findings.
description: examples/sse_listen.rs and examples/ws_loop.rs are deliberately minimal. Header comments scope each out of production use ('single-shot, no retry, no auth, no TLS', 'single connection, no retry'). Both use NoneAuth and ws://, intentionally not modelling production auth/TLS. The SSE example actually defends against the JMAP-6lsm.2-class wire-bug by using a proper SSE response framing including Content-Type: text/event-stream. A future contributor might propose 'make the examples production-grade with reconnect logic' — DO NOT accept that scope change; the examples are docs.rs surface, not a reference client. The right place to demonstrate production reconnect is a separate crate (or PLAN.md prose), not by growing the examples.
title: DECISION: examples scoped narrowly with explicit production caveats
